purpose: Machine-readable QC specification for the masks returned by the expert annotator. Consumed by expert_validation/analysis/validate_annotations.py and scripts/validate_expert_pilot_package.py.

image.dimensions: identical to the private source image; never resized, cropped, rotated or re-encoded
image.metadata: none permitted: no EXIF, IPTC, XMP or PNG textual chunk

vessel_mask.dimensions: must equal the paired image width and height exactly
vessel_mask.optional_when: vessels_gradable == FALSE; a missing file is valid and expected

disc_mask.dimensions: must equal the paired image width and height exactly
disc_mask.optional_when: disc_gradable == FALSE; a missing file is valid and expected

av_labels.scope: only for the images listed for artery/vein labelling
av_labels.granularity: whole major vessel branch, not per pixel

allowed_values.disc_x: number, blank when disc_gradable is FALSE
allowed_values.disc_y: number, blank when disc_gradable is FALSE
allowed_values.disc_radius: number, blank when disc_gradable is FALSE

forbidden_in_package: any original image path or filename
any model prediction, probability or Grad-CAM
any source, label, split, group or geometry identifier
any internal result, threshold or acceptance target
